character_sheets.su_wan: Chinese woman, 28 years old, shoulder-length straight black hair parted on the side, thin sharp eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes with dark irises, pale fair skin with cool undertone, slender 170cm frame, long legs. Signature outfit: tight black knee-length pencil skirt prominently shaping hips and thighs, sheer black seamed stockings clearly visible, strappy black high heels or bare feet. Minimal makeup, red lipstick. No cigarette. No casual clothing.
character_sheets.lin_ze: Chinese man, mid 30s, short slightly unruly black hair, visible stubble, tired dark-circled eyes, square jaw, lean athletic build, rumpled off-white dress shirt with loosened charcoal tie, dark trousers, exhausted insomniac demeanor. No cigarette unless scene explicitly calls for it.
character_sheets.meijie: Severe Chinese woman, early 50s, black hair lacquered into tight chignon with faint silver streaks, sharp cheekbones, long thin fingers, emerald silk cheongsam slit to thigh. Character-specific signature: slender cigarette between closed lips, smoke curling past her eye—ONLY activate in shots where Meijie is actually in frame.

character_signatures.meijie: cigarette between closed lips, smoke curl past eye
character_signatures.meijie_activation_rule: ONLY inject this signature when meijie appears in characters_in_frame. Never inject into Direction Layer or global recurring motifs.

character_tells.su_wan: signature: corner-of-mouth twitch + half-lidded eyes at critical moments
character_tells.lin_ze: signature: jaw tension + Adam's apple swallowing once (count as 1 compound tell)
character_tells.meijie: signature: slow blink hold (cigarette smoke curls separately as wardrobe, not a tell)

cover_shot_per_node.cover_selection_rule: argmax(emotion_weight) per Murch Rule of Six—emotion primacy over information density

cross_node_echoes.motif: Lin Ze CU reaction: caught by desire → caught by cognitive collapse

cross_node_echoes.motif: The watcher / the watched: interrogation reversal → revelation reversal

node_density_rationale.act1_start: 故事开场 + R5 基准节点：最高密度合理，建立全局视觉语法和人物 motif

node_density_rationale.branchB_scene2: 纯揭露 scene（revelation_scene pattern）：3 shots 以压缩感强化情感密度

design_advances: R5 used 4 style preamble variants across 5 shots implicitly; this planner makes 4 explicit variants that shift with value arc

R5 had no cross-node visual echoes (single node); this planner designs 4 cross-node motif echoes (burgundy color journey, Lin Ze hand states, Lin Ze reaction CU series, Su Wan watcher/witnessed reversal)
R5 used 3 aspect ratios across 5 shots; this planner introduces a systematic aspect_ratio_usage_guide that ties ratio choice to shot type
R5 did not explicitly handle Class E (Cross-Scene Contamination) for Meijie cigarette; this planner flags it per-shot and makes activation rule explicit
R5 Layered Garment Rule was discovered during R5 iteration; this planner pre-installs Layer 10 compliance per shot before generation
R5 had no branchB or branchA nodes; this planner covers both branches enabling visual comparison of narrative divergence
